FIELDS.NAME: Reliable Post & Ship Center
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Reliable Post & Ship Center specializes in providing comprehensive mailing and shipping services, including domestic and international shipping, package pickup and drop-off, and postal services through partnerships with major carriers like USPS, UPS, and FedEx. Our operations are designed to ensure customer satisfaction, featuring knowledgeable staff trained in shipping logistics, safety, and customer service. We are located in a high-traffic retail area that enhances accessibility for our customers while maintaining low-security risks. Our facility is equipped with secure storage and has implemented a robust inventory management system to streamline operations. We strictly adhere to regulatory guidelines, ensuring compliance with postal regulations and avoiding any prohibited, hazardous, or illegal shipments. Additionally, we offer self-service kiosks and digital solutions to improve efficiency and reduce manual handling.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not accept any operations that lack the necessary federal, state, and local licenses, and confirms that there are no unresolved regulatory violations or ongoing investigations. Additionally, we do not engage with shipping centers located in high-crime areas or with a history of theft or vandalism, and we strictly prohibit the acceptance or shipping of any prohibited, hazardous, or illegal items without appropriate controls in place.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES:
On 03/15/2023, theft of merchandise valued at $1,500 occurred during a late-night break-in. The incident was reported to the police, and security measures have since been enhanced. Status: Resolved.  
On 06/10/2023, an accidental damage incident where a customer dropped a package resulted in a claim of $1,000 for replacement costs. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class I, Grade A, UL Listed Safe with digital locking mechanism, secure storage for cash and sensitive documents.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing with monitored camera surveillance and regular patrols by security personnel.
